thread:
eva: Nightly eval flagged a regression on llama4b-int8 after calibration. Recall@1 down ~7.2% on kb-retrieval set. CC: @sanjay @rob :eyes:
ci-bot: Nightly run 2034560000 completed. Model: llama4b-int8-calib, commit: a1b2c3f. Alert: recall@1 -7.2% vs baseline.
sanjay: Can you paste diffs? which prompt buckets are the failures in?
eva: Pasting minimal diff from nightly: ```{
  "baseline": { "recall@1": 0.814, "accuracy": 0.782 },
  "current":  { "recall@1": 0.742, "accuracy": 0.760 },
  "delta":    { "recall@1": -0.072, "accuracy": -0.022 }
}``` Most failures are in the long-context KB prompts (ctx > 1024) and some numeric-recall cases.
rob: FP8 build (llama4b-fp8) looks stable on the same suite. Suggests the problem is in the INT8 calibration path.
anya: FWIW I hit a similar skew last month when per-channel scales hit tiny values after fused LayerNorm+GELU. Per-tensor fallbacks fixed it. Try re-run with --calib-mode=per_tensor.
eva: Re-ran a quick shard with per_tensor: cmd: ```./eval.py --model llama4b-int8 --calib-mode per_tensor --seed 42 --split kb-retrieval-shard7``` Result: recall@1 back within 0.8% of baseline.
ci-bot: Re-run 2034568100 finished — per_tensor: recall delta -0.009 (i.e. -0.9%).
rob: Good sign. So calibration per_channel path causes numeric underflow/overflow on some post-LN activations. Any offending layers in logs?
eva: Snippet from quantizer log showing problematic scales: ```[WARN] layer=23 scale=3.2e-40 clipped->0.0; kv_cache_norm=1.02e-12; note: fused_ln_gelu kernel=fast_fuse_v2```
sanjay: Assigning to myself to root cause and add instrumentation to dump scales+sample activations for layers 20-26. ETA ~2h. Will try the same seed and input that triggered failures. I'll also run with smaller calibration batches.
deploy-bot: Canary for llama4b-int8 paused for rolling deploys until investigation completes.
anya: :thumbsup: Also add a tiny unit test that compares per_channel vs per_tensor calibs on synthetic long-inputs (ctx 2k, numeric-heavy) so it lands in CI.
eva: I'll open a bug with reproducer + links to nightly job artifacts: https://redwood.ci/jobs/2034560000 and attach the per_channel/ per_tensor dumps. Thanks all.
